description: This file implements a fake timer and clock control system for testing purposes, including classes and functions to manipulate timers, performance, Date, and other global objects within a JavaScript environment.

classes.name: ClockController
classes.description: Main class managing the fake clock, timers, and synchronization with real time.

methods.name: createClock
methods.description: Creates a new ClockController and API for controlling timers and time.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs fake timers and clock into the global object, replacing native implementations.

methods.name: inject
methods.description: Injects the fake clock and timers into the global object and resumes clock operation.
